name: Foko Lab
description: A responsive scientific identity built from three views of one model state: a continuous dynamics/fitness manifold, an inference and uncertainty plane, and a discrete population/agent lattice. A warm state axis connects the layers; an evolutionary branch emerges from the discrete level. The identity therefore represents the platform's modeling logic rather than one laboratory or AI method.

responsive_system.flagship: foko-lab-emblem.svg and display lockup: full manifold, uncertainty geometry, population lattice, evolutionary branch, shared state axis, and the Modeling · Simulation · Validation descriptor
responsive_system.compact: foko-lab-mark.svg and adaptive shell: three model layers with enough scientific detail for headers and navigation
responsive_system.micro: foko-lab-micro.svg and raster favicons: two structural layers and the shared state only

principles: One scientific object is observed through continuous, inferential and discrete model layers
The state/evidence axis is stable while exact-lab and subject accents can adapt in the application shell
Evolution is present as branching from a population layer, not as a decorative tree
The state axis plus upper layers hide an abstract F while the evolutionary split suggests K, a restrained Foko Kuate signature that never outranks the scientific reading
The flagship emblem is allowed more information than a favicon; responsive simplification is intentional
Scientific plots retain independent semantic palettes; identity color never encodes numerical magnitude
Validation names a workflow of confronting model output with diagnostics and evidence; the identity never presents it as automatic certification of a user model
No brain, gear, quantum, neural-cloud, generic AI, or copied cultural motif
